tagline: Premier operator of top-tier assets in U.S. shale basins, generating strong free cash flow and shareholder returns
hero_kpi_rationale: Net production of 75.5 MMBOE, up 21%, represents the key operational driver, fueled by full integration of Uinta Basin assets and the strategic merger with Civitas that strengthens the multi-basin portfolio.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested each year in productive infrastructure such as wells and production equipment.
kpis.description: The 2026 capex program focuses on asset development in the Midland Basin, South Texas, Uinta Basin, and DJ Basin.
kpis.signal: 2026 capex plan between $2.65 and $2.85 billion, centered on profitable oil projects.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of oil, gas, and natural gas liquids.
kpis.description: Revenue growth is driven by a 21% increase in average daily production, despite a 3% decline in realized prices per BOE.
kpis.signal: 17% growth in 2025 due to 21% higher production.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Not disclosed in the 2025 10-K. The filing provides net income but not explicit EBIT or operating income.

kpis.name: Net Margin
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by total revenue, measuring net profitability.
kpis.description: Calculated from $3.1 billion in revenue and $648 million in net income for 2025.
kpis.signal: Net margin of 20.9% in 2025 (net income $648M on $3.1B revenue).

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Spending on research and development relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Not applicable. SM Energy is an exploration and production company with no significant R&D activities.

kpis.name: Net Production (barrel of oil equivalent)
kpis.explanation: Total volume of oil and gas produced, converted into barrel of oil equivalent (BOE).
kpis.description: Growth is driven by a full year of production in the Uinta Basin (acquired in 2024) and the strategic merger with Civitas, which expands the portfolio.
kpis.signal: Net production of 75.5 MMBOE in 2025, up 21% compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDAX
kpis.explanation: Non-GAAP measure of operating cash flow before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization, and adjustments for exploration.
kpis.description: Key performance indicator used by SM Energy to assess operational profitability and cash flow generation capacity.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBITDAX of $2.3 billion in 2025, supported by higher production and $2.0 billion in operating cash flows.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from core operating activities, before investments and financing.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow funded $69 million in debt reduction, increased cash on hand to $368 million, and returned capital to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Operating cash flow of $2.0 billion in 2025, up 11% from $1.8 billion in 2024.

risks.title: Uncertain Post-Merger Integration
risks.score_rationale: The risk is repeated multiple times in the 10-K with strong language (material adverse effect). It concerns the success of the merger with Civitas, a central event completed on January 30, 2026. The Competition category reflects the impact on the multi-basin strategic position. High weighting due to operational scale and integration of a $2.4 billion stock merger.

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in the document and cited as affecting profitability, cash flows, and access to capital. Recurrent language and high intensity (adversely affect). A major structural risk for the oil and gas sector. Macro category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Cyber Threats from Digital Technologies
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of increasing reliance on digital technologies and associated incident risks. Concerned language (puts us at risk). Growing use of digital tools and AI amplifies exposure. Cybersecurity category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Regulatory Restrictions on Fracking and Emissions
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs dedicated to federal and state initiatives on hydraulic fracturing, emissions, and climate. Strong language (increased costs, operating restrictions). Direct impact on operational costs and timelines. Regulation category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on Third Parties for Transportation
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a major operational risk related to firm transportation contracts. Mentions fixed payments even without full delivery. Concerned language (adversely affected). Direct impact on liquidity and margins. Industrial category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Potential Post-Merger Litigation
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of litigation risks (class actions, derivative suits) related to the Civitas merger. Clear language on substantial costs and diversion of management resources. Litigation category moderately weighted, but high impact on post-closing management.

risks.title: Limitation on Use of Tax Attributes
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a specific risk under Sections 382/383 of the federal tax code. Technical but concerned language (may be limited). Narrower in scope than other post-merger risks, but potentially costly long-term. Regulation category heavily weighted, though limited in scope.

risks.title: Disruption of Historical Business Relationships
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as a risk in merger-related risk factors. Uncertainty surrounding the Civitas merger (completed January 30, 2026) could affect long-standing strategic partnerships. Moderate impact as key relationships are expected to be preserved post-integration.

ai_positioning.summary: SM Energy explicitly mentions the use of digital technologies, data analytics, and AI in operations to optimize well efficiency and performance, but lacks a distinctive, centralized AI strategy.
evidence: Use of advanced digital technology, data analytics, and AI in operations
Goal to optimize capital efficiency and well performance through technological innovation
